component.name: Unpackr
component.summary: Low-disk-space archive extraction engine and native GUI

description.p: Unpackr is a production-quality, low-disk-space archive extraction engine and native desktop GUI. It eliminates the classic 2x disk capacity requirement when extracting large archives by progressively punching physical filesystem holes in already-decompressed archive blocks in-place.

ul.li: In-place physical block reclamation using fallocate (FALLOC_FL_PUNCH_HOLE)
Robust crash recovery and resumable extractions with transactional manifest tracking
Path traversal (Zip Slip) immunity, symlink poisoning detection, and resource limit sandboxing
Zero-copy sparse streaming hole restoration for sparse payloads
Modern native desktop GUI powered by egui/eframe with real-time speed, ETA, and progress charts
Native desktop GUI with real-time progressive extraction metrics
Low-disk space progressive archive reclamation engine
Transactional crash recovery and jobs management
